query:
query FindManyFrontComponents {
  frontComponents {
    id
    name
    applicationId
    builtComponentChecksum
    builtComponentPath
    componentName
    createdAt
    description
    isHeadless
    widgetAvailability {
      pageLayoutType
      objectMetadataId
      __typename
    }
    sourceComponentPath
    universalIdentifier
    updatedAt
    usesSdkClient
    frontComponentSharedDependenciesChecksum
    __typename
  }
}
